Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through Endeavor's priorities. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary goals: reduce response latency on customer-facing assistants and centralize model serving across teams.
- Main constraints: PCI-adjacent data flows, strict change windows, and desire for predictable cost per 1M tokens.

We suggested a short 30-minute product intro / demo that will cover: the runtime, routing/fallback options, and a brief look at cost controls. For that session it would be helpful to have an engineer (for the technical Qs) and someone owning procurement or platform (for rollout questions).

Proposed 30-minute slots (all PT):
1) Tue 2026-10-06 10:00–10:30 PT
2) Wed 2026-10-07 09:00–09:30 PT
3) Thu 2026-10-08 11:30–12:00 PT

If none of these work, tell me a couple of windows that do and Ill send a calendar invite. Im attaching a one-pager with a high-level overview you can share with the team.

Thanks — Ill block time tentatively for option 1 and will cancel if you pick another slot.

Best,
